$comment: Content of the public /ai-transparency page (apps/web/src/pages/ai-transparency.tsx). Replace the example operator and contact before going live. Models are read from config/ai-models.json.

uses.title: Project summaries
uses.what: When you add a description to a project, a language model writes a one-sentence summary of it.
uses.data: The project name and description you entered. Nothing else about you or your organization is sent.
uses.oversight: The summary is labeled "AI-generated" until a member of your organization confirms or corrects it. Corrections replace the summary; the original output stays in the audit log.

uses.title: Quality checks of AI output
uses.what: We check the quality of AI output: before a change ships, against a fixed set of made-up examples, and, if enabled, by letting a second language model grade a small sample of recent outputs against fixed, versioned criteria in our quality tool. The grade is used for monitoring only and never changes what you see.
uses.data: The same input and output as the original AI use (for project summaries: the project name, description and the generated summary).
uses.oversight: Grades and your confirmations or corrections are reviewed by our team in the quality tool (PostHog or a self-hosted Langfuse); they never change a result on their own.

contest: Any member of the organization can correct an AI-generated summary on the project page; the correction is recorded with their name and time.
Organization admins can export the full log of AI calls (purpose, model, time, outcome) from the AI calls page.
To ask how a result was produced or to object to the use of AI, write to the contact address below.
